title: Model Service Metadata
description: Static description of a model service. Returned by GET /info on every model service.

name.description: Stable kebab/snake-case identifier. Used as the registration key.

version.description: Semantic version of the model implementation

snapshot_schema_version.description: Major version of the snapshot schema this model accepts (e.g. '1')

action_schema_version.description: Major version of the action schema this model emits (e.g. '1')

decision_interval_steps.description: Number of simulation steps between /predict calls. Manager applies default control between calls.

supports_warm_start.description: If true, /predict produces useful actions immediately after /reset. If false, Manager applies default control during the warmup_steps window returned from /reset.

max_inference_ms.description: Maximum acceptable wall-clock time per /predict call. Manager uses this as the request timeout.

needs_vehicle_data.description: If true, Manager includes per-vehicle data in the snapshot (more bandwidth).

tags.description: Free-form tags surfaced in the dashboard model picker (e.g. ['gnn', 'marl', 'attention'])
